methodology.statement: Catalog-only assessment draft covering all version records. The data does not include actual installed DLL hashes, full provider-feed records, transitive closure, runtime feature evidence or local reviewed revisions.
Published upstream affected/fixed version ranges are not synonymous with verified BuildEngine exploitability. An upstream source fix is not treated as evidence of the loaded DLL.
methodology.importPolicy: Do not import or overwrite review database automatically; map only identified provider_finding/build_finding pairs and append reviewed assessment revisions with evidence fingerprints.
